name: Decline Push-Up
summary: A push-up with the feet raised that puts more load on the upper chest and shoulders than a floor push-up.
setup: Place your feet on a sturdy bench, sofa or chair and your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Make sure the support is stable and will not slide.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes so your body is straight.
Keep your head in line with your spine.
execution: Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your hips from sagging or piking.
Press the floor away to the start.
Use a lower platform if you cannot keep the line.
mistakes: Hips sagging: brace the abs and squeeze glutes, or lower the foot height.
Shoulders shrugging up: keep them pulled down and away from the ears.
Feet on an unstable surface: use a sturdy one.
